Ooredoo الجزائر الراعي البلاتيني للأولمب: Ooredoo Algeria Platinum Sponsor of the African Skills Olympics 2026 in Oran
وفاءً لالتزامها بدعم الشباب وتنمية الكفا: True to its commitment to supporting youth, developing skills, and promoting talent, Ooredoo Algeria, as a Platinum Sponsor, accompanied the events of the second edition of the African Skills Olympics 2026, recently hosted by the city of Oran.
تحت الرعاية السامية لرئيس الجمهورية، الس: Under the high patronage of the President of the Republic, Mr. Abdelmadjid Tebboune, and organized by the Ministry of Vocational Training and Education, this continental event brought together competing youth from 18 African countries, who came to showcase their skills, highlight their professional achievements, and compete in various specialties.
حضي جناح العرض الخاص بـ Ooredooالجزائر ف: The exhibition booth of Ooredoo Algeria at this event was visited by Mrs. Wassima Arhab, Minister of Vocational Training and Education, who reviewed the company's various initiatives in the field of training.
خلال الحفل الختامي لهذا الحدث القاري، تم: During the closing ceremony of this continental event, Ooredoo was honored in recognition of its sponsorship and support for this event of continental scale.
بمشاركة أكثر من 600 متنافس في مسابقات شم: With the participation of more than 600 competitors in contests covering 45 trades, this edition constituted a space for exchange, acquisition of experience, and positive competition, as well as an opportunity to promote and value professional skills across the African continent. In this context, representatives from Ooredoo organized a workshop titled: "Leadership in the Age of Artificial Intelligence."
بمرافقتها لهذا الحدث، تؤكد Ooredoo الجزا: By accompanying this event, Ooredoo Algeria reaffirms its commitment to contributing to initiatives that place human capital development at the core of its priorities and values talent and skills.
